english.title: Disclose confidential information regarding designation / variation / revocation of statement of reasons
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been provided with or otherwise obtained information to be treated as confidential in accordance with regulation 9(1) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021 without lawful authority, disclosed it or part of it knowing or having reasonable cause to suspect that it was to be treated as confidential
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(2) and (6) and 31(2)(a) and (d) of the Global Anti-Corruption Sanctions Regulations 2021.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
